name: Molmo2-8B
notes: Fully open model (weights, data and code) on a Qwen3-8B backbone. Weights are stored in 32-bit, so the download is large. On a 20 GB slice nothing was left for the context cache once its large image batch was reserved, so it runs on 40 GB. Documents are not a stated use; it is here as the open-data reference. One page image is up to 12,284 tokens, so the batch token limit is raised to fit it.
